title: Analyse the situation of the target environment.
description: Collect and process the appropriate information needed about the cybersecurity related condition of the target environment (e.g. an organisation) to create a baseline. Identify the parties involved and the goal to be achieved.
figure_reference: Figure 4: A modular five-step guide to apply the ECSF
source_document: ENISA, User Manual: European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF), September 2022 (KB 2/Europe/ENISA European Cybersecurity Skills Framework User Manual.pdf)

title: Identify specific objectives to be achieved.
description: Look into the status of the target environment and identify any specific cybersecurity-related requirements to be covered or any objective to be achieved by the targeted environment. Depending on the situation, it may be possible to use the ECSF as a taxonomy to identify the objectives in question.
figure_reference: Figure 4: A modular five-step guide to apply the ECSF
source_document: ENISA, User Manual: European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF), September 2022 (KB 2/Europe/ENISA European Cybersecurity Skills Framework User Manual.pdf)

title: Select the appropriate components of the ECSF.
description: Review the ECSF profiles and select profiles that are relevant to a particular situation. Then select the components that assist in covering the needs or achieving the required objectives of the targeted environment.
figure_reference: Figure 4: A modular five-step guide to apply the ECSF
source_document: ENISA, User Manual: European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF), September 2022 (KB 2/Europe/ENISA European Cybersecurity Skills Framework User Manual.pdf)

title: Adapt the selected components according to your needs.
description: Make appropriate changes on selected components to better fit a particular situation and/or targeted environment. The ECSF profiles and/or their components can be mixed, split, or brought into a sector specific context according to the needs of each situation.
figure_reference: Figure 4: A modular five-step guide to apply the ECSF

title: Apply the customised components to the target environment.
description: Take action using the tailored ECSF components to cover security related objectives required to improve the situation of the target environment and to achieve the organisational goal.
